import numpy as np

# Quaternions: gripper facing down, fingers opening along X (to grasp the Y-aligned handle)
Q0_DOWN_X = np.array([0.0, 0.707, 0.707, 0.0])   # arm0
Q1_DOWN_X = np.array([0.0, -0.707, 0.707, 0.0])  # arm1 (rotated [0,0,1,0] by 90deg about Z)

# Handover location: midpoint between initial gripper positions (~x=0.81)
HX = 0.81
Z_HAND = 0.18            # hammer z during handover (0.15 < z < 0.20)
ARM0_GRASP_OFF = -0.045  # arm0 grasps handle slightly toward the head (-Y)
ARM1_GRASP_OFF = +0.055  # arm1 grasps handle toward +Y end -> 10cm separation between grippers
ARM0_HAND_Y = -0.05
ARM1_HAND_Y = ARM0_HAND_Y + (ARM1_GRASP_OFF - ARM0_GRASP_OFF)

# 1. Open both grippers, move arm1 out of the way (high, toward its own side)
open_gripper_arm0()
open_gripper_arm1()
goto_pose_arm1(np.array([1.05, ARM1_HAND_Y, 0.35]), Q1_DOWN_X)

# 2. Arm0 grasps hammer handle from above (approach vertically)
hpos, _ = get_hammer_pose()
hx, hy, hz = float(hpos[0]), float(hpos[1]), float(hpos[2])
grasp0 = np.array([hx, hy + ARM0_GRASP_OFF, hz + 0.005])
goto_pose_arm0(grasp0, Q0_DOWN_X, z_approach=0.15)
close_gripper_arm0()

# 3. Lift straight up, then translate to handover point (keep handle along Y), then settle to handover z
z_lift = max(hz + 0.15, Z_HAND + 0.05)
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([hx, hy + ARM0_GRASP_OFF, z_lift]), Q0_DOWN_X)
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([HX, ARM0_HAND_Y, z_lift]), Q0_DOWN_X)
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([HX, ARM0_HAND_Y, Z_HAND]), Q0_DOWN_X)

# 4. Arm1 approaches the handle (+Y side) from above and grasps
goto_pose_arm1(np.array([HX, ARM1_HAND_Y, 0.35]), Q1_DOWN_X)
goto_pose_arm1(np.array([HX, ARM1_HAND_Y, Z_HAND]), Q1_DOWN_X, z_approach=0.12)
close_gripper_arm1()

# 5. Arm0 releases and retreats (up first, then back toward its own side)
open_gripper_arm0()
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([HX, ARM0_HAND_Y, Z_HAND + 0.15]), Q0_DOWN_X)
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([0.50, ARM0_HAND_Y, Z_HAND + 0.15]), Q0_DOWN_X)
